extracted.name: Bang Bang Sauce
extracted.description: This creamy, sweet, tiny-bit-spicy pink sauce was popularised in America as the sauce for "Bang Bang Shrimp" - crispy fried prawns tossed din the sauce - but the world quickly discovered it's just as good with burgers, wraps, tacos, fries and even as a salad dressing!This goes particularly well with the Prawn Burgers that I also published today (Shrimp Burgers).
ingredient_lines: 1 tbsp sriracha (, or other chilli sauce you want, adjust amount to control spiciness (Note 3))
instruction_lines: Use for smearing in burgers, wraps (Doner Kebabs!), sandwiches, as a dipping sauce for fries, wedges, chicken fingers, drizzle across salads and poke bowls. And soon, I will share my Bang Bang Shrimp recipe!
